Policy identified: Arunachal Pradesh Startup Policy 2022-23
Policy period: 2022-2027
OFFICIAL GOVERNMENT SOURCE
https://www.startupindia.gov.in/content/sih/en/state-startup-policies/Arunachal-Pradesh-state-policy.html
EVIDENCE SUMMARY
Startup India lists the Arunachal Pradesh Startup Policy 2022-23. The policy provides annual entrepreneurship challenges, selecting 50 startups each year for five years; the top 10 can receive Rs. 5 lakh each with incubation and the next 40 Rs. 4 lakh each with pre-incubation. It also provides support for proof of concept, including support through the Startup India Seed Fund Scheme and state support for eligible startups not accommodated under that scheme.
CURRENT-POLICY CAUTION

Jharkhand as state exhibits robust business- friendly ecosystem, promoting innovation
and nurturing entrepreneurial spirits. The government of Jharkhand is dedicated to craft
opportunities for various stratums of the society by providing an equitable ecosystem for the
development of entrepreneurship and innovation.

The state through this policy is providing a hand holding approach for start-ups by
enabling, empowering and engaging them from a very nascent stage and be the partner in
their growth journey. The policy focuses on systematic effective pathway with short-term
orientation to boost entrepreneurship, revitalize the economy, and investment in the state in
coming 5 years and also paves a strategic long-term roadmap for inculcating and promoting
the culture of entrepreneurship at individual as well as societal level.

andREI's .

Recognizing Bengaluru’s global leadership in the

What qualifies as a “Startup” under the MP Startup Policy 2022?
“Startup” means an entity which is recognized by Startup India under the Government of India, Ministry of Commerce and Industry Department of Industry Promotion and Internal Trade, and is established and registered in the State of Madhya Pradesh. Basically, an entity holding a valid DPIIT recogination number and certificate. To apply for DPIIT recognistion, please visit, www.startupindia.gov.in
How can Startup login to MP Startup Portal
Startup who are recognised by Startup India, DPIIT, GoI can login in MP Startup Poral by using the same username and password what they have used for login on Startup India Portal.
How does a Startup obtain benefits under the MP Startup Policy 2022?
Startups who have successfully loggedin to MP startup portal can apply on for financial assistance on the Portal itself, with all the relevant documents.

StartupTN has identiﬁed Seven Determinants to enable a solid architecture of
the State Startup Ecosystem which is envisaged to function in a synchronised manner.
Given the current global socio-economic trends and the rapid technology
transformations, this policy is designed to enable the Determinants to complement
one another. Through this seamlessly integrated model, the physical or intellectual
assets developed or established can be ploughed back into the system to nurture the
Startup community. In short, the policy’s architecture is designed to enable both the
community’s transformative mindset and the emergence of path breaking Startups.

9. ADVISORY BOARD
For the successful implementation of this Policy, an Advisory Board will be
formed that will guide through the Seven Determinants. The advisory board will be
constituted with representation from prospective Startups, Investors, Mentors,
Incubation Managers, Domain Experts, Government, Media, Industry Forums,
Corporate Establishments, representatives from Women, and SC/ST forums and other

discuss the Policy outcomes and suggest strategies that can be evolved from time to
time and will assess the implementation guidelines, considering prevailing
socio-economic trends. This will enable the Advisory Board to guide and suggest new
initiatives for the new Policy in the upcoming years.
